title: Part Seven: The Maps at the UN and the "Very Much" Interview

sections.brief: Netanyahu's maps: UNGA 22 Sep 2023 ('Israel in 1948' and 'The New Middle East', West Bank/Gaza/East Jerusalem unmarked; stated purpose: Saudi peace, no Palestinian 'veto'), Germany and US responses, no Israeli clarification; Philadelphi press conference 2 Sep 2024 (West Bank shown as Israel); UNGA 27 Sep 2024 'Blessing'/'Curse' (West Bank/Gaza point reported only via Anadolu/MEMO); fact vs pattern vs argument. Figure: compare

i24NEWS interview aired 12 Aug 2025 (Sharon Gal): the pendant, the question, the differing renderings ('very much', 'very much so', 'very attached', 'absolutely'; Hebrew not found); Jordan, Egypt, Saudi, Arab League, Qatar, Iraq, PA; the 16 Aug joint statement of 31 states + Arab League/OIC/GCC; E1 the same week; Israel's reply via Haaretz (did not use the words); what the remark does and does not establish. Figures: compare; time
